title: 和高分的约会，是更高规格的实战训练

coverage.excluded_asr_tail: S00035-S00051 extend beyond the audited media duration and are excluded from claims.

timeline.summary: Asked whether relaxed dating comes from accumulating sessions, Mikey says both repetition and the perceived difficulty or social status of partners affect learning.
He describes the course as preserving a student's personality baseline while optimizing it and adding missing strengths.
Asked how to make a girlfriend accept other partners, he recommends displaying abundance and argues that a heavily invested partner may tolerate it.
He contrasts a new, lightly invested partner who may simply leave. The media ends here; the remaining ASR is excluded as hallucinated tail.

claims.speaker: Mikey
claims.statement: Social composure develops through both repetition and harder practice contexts; he claims one date with a highly desired woman can teach more than many easy encounters.
claims.conditions: Unmeasured coaching claim using derogatory rankings of women; do not treat people as training objects.

claims.speaker: Mikey
claims.statement: His stated coaching model is to preserve a person's underlying character while optimizing it and adding missing strengths.
claims.conditions: High-level self-development framing; the short does not define objective evaluation criteria or outcomes.

claims.speaker: Mikey
claims.statement: He advises signaling that one does not need a girlfriend so she will not dare demand exclusivity.
claims.conditions: Coercive relationship framing; non-monogamy requires prior informed and freely revocable agreement, not fear or status pressure.

claims.speaker: Mikey
claims.statement: He claims a partner who has invested heavily and feels unable to leave is more likely to accept multiple partners, whereas a new partner may exit.
claims.conditions: Sunk-cost manipulation is not consent and must not be turned into advice.

speaker_attribution.speaker: viewers

speaker_attribution.speaker: Mikey

visual_findings: All 23 frames show one continuous black-shirt livestream host with a fixed diagram/chat overlay and added yellow subtitles.
No girlfriend or dating participant appears; the relationship claims are host commentary, not observed interactions.

permissions.reason: Already represented by formal live-028; includes objectification, coercive non-monogamy framing and sunk-cost manipulation.

limitations: The automatic transcript contains an incoherent hallucinated tail after the 69.032925-second media endpoint.
The short combines several Q&A snippets and omits parent-stream context.
Claims about women's reactions and training value are not independently validated.
